q1.question: Amek ara ɛerḍeɣ Trokacha?
q1.answer: Trokacha yella s lqem BETA! Sider-it seg TestFlight (iOS) neɣ d APK (Android) srid seg usebter-agi. Tikkin-nwen tɛawen-aɣ ad nesnerni aseddu send ad d-yeffeɣ s wudem unṣib.

q2.question: Amek i yeddu umsenfel di Trokacha?
q2.answer: Ssufeɣ talɣut-ik, wali tid n medden. I usumer: ldi talɣut i k-iɛeǧben sakin senned ɣef « Sumer », fren amsenfel (s yiwet neɣ snat seg telɣutin-ik) neɣ idrimen. Ma yeqbel wayeḍ, tedda! Tzemreḍ ad tmeslayeḍ yid-s.

q3.question: Assiweḍ n tqecwalt d laman?
q3.answer: Ih! Yal asiwweḍ yettwasenqed, tamezdagnut tesmizwir-it. Tzemreḍ ad tḍefṛeḍ taqecwalt-ik srid ɣef tkarḍa, ad tmeslayeḍ d usiwweḍ.

q4.question: Trokacha d baṭel?
q4.answer: Ih! Trokacha d baṭel maṛṛa! Ulac idrimen uffiren, ulac amtawa. Yella wayen premium ma tebɣiḍ, maca akk timahilin tigejdanin d baṭel.

q5.question: Anida ara yili Trokacha?
q5.answer: Trokacha ad yili di yal tawilayit n Lezzayer seg tazwara. Iswi-nneɣ: ad neqqen Izzayriyen seg Tmanɣest ar Ɛennaba!

q6.question: Amek ara iliɣ d asiwweḍ di Trokacha?
q6.answer: Xleq amiḍan-ik, rmed afran n usiwweḍ. Ad tezmireḍ ad twaliḍ tussniwin n ussiweḍ ɣef yiberdan-ik, ad tessumeṛ lxedma-k.

privacy.title: Aḥraz n tbaḍnit
privacy.intro: S lḥukum n usaḍuf 18-07 n 10 yunyu 2018 ɣef ummesten n yimdanen deg usesfer n yisefka udmawanen, yettubeddlen s usaḍuf 11-25 n yulyu 2025, Trokacha yettḥaraz isefka udmawanen n yiseqdacen-is.

a1.title: Amagrad 1 – Amsebded n usesfer
a1.content: Trokacha – Aseddu n uselɣu srid – Lezzayer

a2.title: Amagrad 2 – Isefka yettwalqḍen
a2.intro: Trokacha yelqeḍ kan isefka ilaqen i wakken ad teddu lxedma:

s1.title: 2.1 – Isefka n timagit
items: Isem, talalit
Imayl, uṭṭun n tilifun
Taswirt n umaɣnu (d afran)

s2.title: 2.2 – Isefka n usenqed n timagit
items: Taswirt n tekarḍa n timagit tunṣibt (carte nationale, turagt n usfar neɣ passeport)
Selfie n usenqed i userwes d tekarḍa
I yisufaṛen: turagt n usfar
s2.note: Isefka-agi ttwasesferlen kan i usenqed n timagit d ufka n tbedyaṭ « Amdan yettwasenqed ». Tiswirin n tekarḍa ttwaḥerzen s unegzum di tegnit n usenqed, dɣa ttwakksen deg 30 n wussan deffir usentem. Kan addad n usenqed (yettwasenqed/ur yettwasenqed ara) i yettwaḥerzen.

s3.title: 2.3 – Isefka n udeg anamkan
items: Adeg anamkan n useqdac (s uqbul-is aḥerfi)
Yettwaseqdac i: abeyyeḍ n telɣutin iqerben, imeẓla n umyafaṛ d ussiweḍ
Asnas n udeg yeddu kan mi yella useddu yermden (ulac alqaḍ deg ugilal)
Aseqdac yezmer ad yens asnas n udeg melmi yebɣa deg yiɣewwaṛen n yibenk-is

s4.title: 2.4 – Isefka n temhalin d useqdec
items: Amazray n telɣutin yeffɣen, imsenfal yettusumren d wid yeddan
Tezmilin gar yiseqdacen
Iznan yettwaznen s ameslay (aḍris, tiswirin, iznan s taɣect, isedduyen)
Isefka n useqdec n useddu (isebtar yettwawalen, tanzagt n tɣimit)
Tinqiḍin, tibedyaḍ d yisefka n twuṛi

s5.title: 2.5 – Isefka itiknikanen
items: Tansa IP
Anaw d lqem n unagraw (iOS, Android)
Tanalt n yibenk
Asulay amayut n yibenk
Isefka n tmellit d uṣeggem (crashes, tuccḍiwin)

a3.title: Amagrad 3 – Tasila tusḍift n usesfer
items: Aqbul: aseqdac yeqbel s ufehm mi yekcem d mi yermad yal tamahilt (adeg, asenqed, ilɣuten)
Aselkem n umsaḍuf: isefka ilaqen i umeẓlu (talɣutin, imsenfal, ameslay, amyafaṛ)
Tiḥuqranin tusḍifin: aḥraz n yisefka s usaḍuf azzayri
Aswehel ameɣtu: aswehel n lkira, taɣellist n useddu, asnerni n umeẓlu

a4.title: Amagrad 4 – Imeẓla n beṛṛa d yimsesfren ifrawanen
a4.intro: Trokacha yesseqdac imeẓla n beṛṛa ilaqen i useddu. Imawlan-agi d imsesfren ifrawanen, qqnen-asen s umsaḍuf ad ḥerzen tuffra n yisefka:

s1.title: 4.1 – Firebase (Google LLC)
items: Firebase Authentication: asefrek n ukcem d umsikel
Cloud Firestore: aḥraz ilmawen n yisefka n useddu (talɣutin, imuɣna, iznan)
Firebase Storage: asekcem n tswirin (tiswirin n telɣutin, tiswirin n umaɣnu)
Firebase Cloud Messaging: tuzna n yilɣuten push
Firebase Crashlytics: tuṭṭfa d useɣti n tuccḍiwin (isefka udlisen)

s2.title: 4.2 – Expo / React Native
s2.content: Tasnakuda tatiknikant i usnulfu d ubḍu n useddu. Ulac isefka udmawanen yettwabḍan d Expo.

s3.title: 4.3 – Imeẓla n useskel
s3.content: Ma llan yifecka n useskel (Firebase Analytics neɣ am netta), isefka yettwalqḍen d udlisen, ttwaseqdacen kan i usnerni n termit n useqdac. Aseqdac yezmer ad yemmeggel di yiɣewwaṛen n useddu.

a5.title: Amagrad 5 – Izerfan-ik
a5.intro: S lḥukum n usaḍuf 18-07, tesɛiḍ izerfan-agi:
items: Azref n unekcum: awi-d akk isefka-k udmawanen ɣer Trokacha
Azref n useɣti: seɣti yal asefka ur nellin ara d ameɣtu neɣ yenqes
Azref n tukksa: suter tukksa n yisefka-k (azref n uttun)
Azref n umeggli: meggel asesfer n yisefka-k ɣef yimensayen imeɣta
Azref n usettefi: suter asettefi n usesfer deg kra n tegnatin
Azref n unkaz: awi-d isefka-k deg umasal yettwabnan, yettwaɣṛan
Azref n tuɣalin deg uqbul: uɣal deg uqbul-ik melmi tebɣiḍ, bla ma yettwaɛṛaḍ usesfer amezwaru
a5.contact: Izerfan-agi zemren ad ttwaselmden ma tnermseḍ-d ɣer
a5.responseDelay: Trokacha ad d-yerr i yal tuttra deg wakud afellay n 30 n wussan.

a6.title: Amagrad 6 – Aḥraz n yisefka
items: Isefka n umiḍan armid: ttwaḥerzen mi yettwaseqdac umiḍan
Amiḍan ur nermid ara: isefka ttwaḥerzen 3 n yiseggasen deffir tamahilt taneggarut
Deffir tukksa n umiḍan: isefka ttwaskelsen s lḥukum dɣa ttwakksen nig
Isefka n usenqed n timagit (tiswirin ID/selfie): ttwakksen deg 30 n wussan deffir usentem
Iznan n chat: ttwaḥerzen mi yella umiḍan, dɣa ttwakksen yid-s
Isefka n uṣeggem d crashes: ttwaḥerzen 90 n wussan d afellay

a7.title: Amagrad 7 – Taɣellist n yisefka
a7.intro: Trokacha yesseqdac tarrayin titeknikkanin d tunẓimin i ummesten n yisefka udmawanen:
items: Anegzum n yisefka deg usenkez (TLS/SSL) d deg usgunfu
Anegzum yettwasnernayen i yisefka iḥulfan (tikarḍiwin n timagit, turagt n usfar)
Ilugan n tɣellist Firebase (Firestore Security Rules) ttaṭṭafen anekcum ɣer yisefka yettusirgen kan
Anekcum yettwaḥebbes s usenqed
Asenqed n tɣellist ilugan
Askelsen ilugan n yisefka

a8.title: Amagrad 8 – Alɣu n trewla
a8.intro: Ma tella trewla n yisefka i yzemren ad d-tawi ugur meqqren i yizerfan-ik:
items: ANPDP ad yettwilɣu deg 5 n wussan (s usaḍuf 11-25)
Iseqdacen yettwaɛnan ad ttwilɣun deg wakud aẓayan s ulɣu deg useddu d/neɣ s imayl
Alɣu ad yegber: anaw n trewla, isefka yettwaɛnan, tarrayin yettwaṭṭfen d yiwellihen i yiseqdacen

a9.title: Amagrad 9 – Asenkez n yisefka
a9.content: Isefka udmawanen ttwasesferlen s yimeẓla Firebase n Google, iqeddacen-is zemren ad ilin beṛṛa i Lezzayer (Tamuḍa n Tuṛuft, Iwunak Yedduklen).
a9.guarantees: Trokacha yettḥaqaq d akken isenkaz-agi sɛan tiḍmanin ilaqen:
items: Google yedda d yinizamiyen igraɣlanen n ummesten n yisefka (SOC 2, ISO 27001)
Iferdisen imṣadayen iluɣmayen ssebdaden isenkaz-agi
Yal turagt tamezwarut i yesra ANPDP ad tettwawi s usaḍuf amiran

a10.title: Amagrad 10 – Iseqdacen imeẓyanen
a10.content: Trokacha ur yettwaxdem ara i yimdanen ddaw 18 n yiseggasen. Ulac ameẓyan i yzemren ad yexleq amiḍan ɣef useddu.
a10.discovery: Ma yaf-d Trokacha d akken aseqdac d ameẓyan, amiḍan-is ad yettwaḥbes srid, isefka-s ad ttwakksen deg 48 n yisragen.
a10.parent: Ma telliḍ d amaru neɣ d amserwes, tḥeqqeḍ mmi-k/yelli-k yexleq amiḍan ɣef Trokacha, nermes-aɣ-d ɣef

a11.title: Amagrad 11 – Isulayen itiknikanen d cookies
a11.intro: Aseddu aziraz Trokacha ur yesseqdac ara cookies. Maca, titiknulujiyin-agi zemrent ad ttwaseqdacent:
items: Asulay n yibenk: i tuzna n yilɣuten push d tɣellist n umiḍan
Tokens n usenqed: ttwaḥerzen srid deg yibenk-ik i uḥraz n tɣimit-ik
Asulay n uselɣu (Advertising ID): ur yettwaseqdac ara sɣur Trokacha. Ulac isefka yettwabeḍḍen i uselɣu
a11.website: Asmel trokacha.com yezmer ad yesseqdec cookies itiknikanen ilaqen. Ulac cookies n uḍfaṛ n uselɣu.

a12.title: Amagrad 12 – Asnifel n tsertit
a12.intro: Trokacha yettḥaraz azref ad yesnfel tasertit-agi n tbaḍnit melmi yebɣa. Iseqdacen ad ttwilɣun s yal asnifel meqqren s:
items: Alɣu deg useddu
Aleqqem n uzemz « aleqqem aneggaru » ufella n useddu-agi
a12.note: Asseqdec igeddlen n Trokacha deffir ulɣu d aqbul n tsertit yettwasniflen.

a13.title: Amagrad 13 – Azref n tẓiḍḍert
a13.intro: Ma tḥeqqeḍ izerfan-ik ur ttwaqadren ara, tzemreḍ:
items: Ad tnermseḍ Trokacha ɣef contact@trokacha.com
Ad teǧǧeḍ taẓiḍḍert ɣer ANPDP (Tamawt Taɣlant n Ummesten n Yisefka Udmawanen)

echange.title: Amsenfel, Tizwert & Tiɣin
echange.subtitle: Wali amek ara tsenfleḍ, tzenzeḍ neɣ taɣeḍ s sshula ɣef Trokacha
echange.stepsSubtitle: Seg tazwara ar tagara, wali yal amecwaṛ

step1.title: Ssufeɣ talɣut-ik
step1.description: Ṭṭef tiswirin ifeclen, rnu aglam leqqayen, sbadu ssuma neɣ ayen tettnadi.
step1.tip: Tiswirin ifeclen d uglam ummid ssnekkaren tignatin!

step2.title: Wali talɣutin
step2.description: Snirem talɣutin n medden. Sizdeg s taggayt, tamurt neɣ anaw.
step2.tip: Seqdec imsizdigen akken ad d-tafeḍ ayen tebɣiḍ s zik.

step3.title: Sumer
step3.description: Talɣut teɛǧeb-ik? Ldi-tt sakin senned ɣef « Sumer », fren amsenfel (s yiwet neɣ snat seg telɣutin-ik) neɣ idrimen.
step3.tip: Yal tigawt s tqeffalt-is: amsenfel neɣ idrimen. D ayen fessusen!

step4.title: Tedda!
step4.description: Ma yeqbel wayeḍ, tedda! Tzemreḍ tura ad tmeslayeḍ yid-s.
step4.tip: Ma tedda, sin-nwen temsefhamem - amṣakkar yezmer ad yebdu.

step5.title: Sentem
step5.description: Ticki twafqem, sentem. Iɣunas-ik seggmen, ur zmiren ara ad ttusumren i wiyaḍ.
step5.tip: Asentem isseggem iɣunas i umsenfel-agi kan.

step6.title: Mlil, senfel
step6.description: Mlil-d akken ad tsenfleḍ neɣ ad tfakeḍ tizwert akken twafqem.

step7.title: Smizwer, fak
step7.description: Deffir umsenfel, smizwer. Tezmilin-ik ttɛawanent tamezdagnut ad teẓer anwa yella d ṣṣaḥ.
step7.tip: Tazmilt tyelha teɛawen-ik ad tebniḍ isem-ik!
